decisions.statement: One name is used for one thing across every tree the editor draws.
A tree names its own row type.
A tree's own row type takes these fields and adds its own fields.
A row has its children under the type that row is.
A value that is absent is null rather than missing.
The service knows the checkout the editor does not join.
A color is a name rather than a value.
The editor has the color each name is drawn as.

definition: the fields every row of every tree the editor draws carries
